items.title: UAB Pulls Away From Charlotte in Fourth Quarter for 23-12 Victory
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB scored 17 unanswered points in the fourth quarter and used another dominant defensive performance to defeat Charlotte, 23-12, Saturday afternoon at Protective Stadium in the 10th annual Children's Harbor Game.

items.title: UAB Hosts Charlotte on Saturday in 10th Annual Children's Harbor Game
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB returns to Protective Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 7, looking to remain unbeaten at home as the Blazers host Charlotte in an American Conference matchup presented by Regions Bank. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:30 p.m. CT, with the game streaming on ESPN+.

items.title: Oliver Straw Named to the Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB punter Oliver Straw has been named to the 2026 Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List, the Augusta Sports Council announced Thursday, Nov. 5.

items.title: Blazers Return Home to Face Charlotte in 10th Annual Children's Harbor Game
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The UAB football team returns to Protective Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 7, looking to remain unbeaten at home as the Blazers host Charlotte in an American Conference matchup highlighted by the 10th annual Children's Harbor Game.

items.title: UAB Football at Temple Set for Noon Kickoff on ESPN+
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM – The American Conference announced Monday that UAB's football game at Temple on Saturday, Nov. 14, will kick off at noon CT (1 p.m. ET) and air live on ESPN+. The matchup will take place at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia and marks the Blazers' final Saturday road contest before the regular-season finale at North Texas on Nov. 28.

items.title: UAB Falls 30-10 at South Florida
items.summary: UAB jumped out to a 10-0 first-quarter lead, but South Florida scored 30 unanswered points, including two defensive touchdowns, to defeat the Blazers 30-10 Saturday afternoon at Raymond James Stadium.

items.title: UAB Travels to South Florida for Halloween Showdown on ESPNU
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB returns to action following its bye week as the Blazers travel to Tampa for an American Conference matchup against South Florida on Saturday, Oct. 31. Kickoff from Raymond James Stadium is scheduled for 11 a.m. CT (noon ET), with the game televised nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: Blazers Return From Bye for American Conference Road Test at South Florida
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – After an extended break from competition, head coach Alex Mortensen and the UAB football team are turning their attention to South Florida as the Blazers prepare to resume American Conference play Saturday in Tampa.

items.title: UAB Athletics Announces 2026 Hall of Fame Class
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB Athletics announced its 2026 Hall of Fame class Tuesday, recognizing five former Blazer student-athletes whose accomplishments helped shape the history and tradition of their respective programs.
